description: Returns 7-year expected annualized real (after-inflation) and nominal returns (%/yr), current real yields, ETF proxy tickers (BIL, SHV, SGOV, IEF, GOVT, TLT, LQD, VCIT, SPY, VOO, IVV), and return-basis assumptions across US Cash (3-Month Treasury Bill), 10-Year US Government Bonds, Investment-Grade Corporate Bonds (Moody's Baa), and the S&P 500 under two valuation baselines: Post-1990 Baseline (+1.22%/yr real, +4.57%/yr nominal) and 100-Year Baseline (-2.72%/yr real, +0.63%/yr nominal).
name: get_cross_asset_7y_forecast
title: Get 7-Year Cross-Asset Expected Returns
